remarks: Welcome to 62 George Avenue! A charming and well maintained cape, with perfect timeless appeal. A flood of natural light greets you as you step into an open and versatile space that allows for ease of living and entertaining alike. The renovated kitchen is truly the heart of this home, with stainless steel appliances, an abundance of storage and plenty of space to allow your inner chef to emerge. Experience the beauty of nature right at your doorstep with a cozy private outdoor oasis. Whether you're hosting gatherings or enjoying a quiet evening under the stars, this yard is a true gem. The second floor features a renovated bathroom and 2 bedrooms that both provide peaceful retreats, are adorned with natural light and offer ample room for personalization.  In the neighborhood, enjoy seamless commuting with easy access to major highways, a 5 minute drive to the East Norwalk MetroNorth station and close proximity to tons of shopping, including Stew Leonards!   Don't miss the opportunity to discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience that awaits you in the Bettswood neighborhood!   Schedule your private tour today!
